mapper.select: SELECT ID AS id, USERNAME AS username, PASSWORD AS password, NAME AS name, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, ROLE AS role, SOCIAL_PROVIDER AS loginProvider FROM MB_USER WHERE SOCIAL_PROVIDER = #{provider} AND SOCIAL_ID = #{socialId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MB_USER WHERE USERNAME = #{username}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MB_USER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MB_USER (USERNAME, PASSWORD, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLE) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, 'CUSTOMER')

INSERT INTO MB_USER (USERNAME, PASSWORD, NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, ROLE, SOCIAL_PROVIDER, SOCIAL_ID) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, 'CUSTOMER', #{loginProvider}, #{socialId})
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_USER SET PASSWORD = #{password}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MB_USER WHERE LOWER(EMAIL) = LOWER(#{email}) AND ID != #{id}
